contracts.title: Codex startup orchestration and hook fallback

Real-home selection first awaits serialized hook ensure; unavailable hook lane selects managed fallback. If preparation clears an untrusted account and returns null, establish real-home hooks and re-resolve once. WSL hook target trims distro then uses default. Managed hook preparation is awaited; status.error or rejection only warns and selected path still returns. Hook ensure internally catches install/rollback failures and sets unavailable; pending/installed/removed lanes remain usable. Unsupported/unsupported-cached/disabled grant fallback caches no retry until process reset; transient failures use cooldown.

No cancellation parameter or common transaction wraps this function.

Restore computes per-file and per-Keychain ownership using exact last-written/baseline bytes or qualified identity; external login/logout is preserved. OAuth metadata restores first, file next, independently owned Keychains afterward. Malformed runtime config preserves file; metadata writes preserve unrelated fields, null/undefined removes oauthAccount. File write and snapshot/Keychain/OAuth operations are not a single transaction; successful local rollback does not prove provider tokens were rolled back.
